nodes.label: Device tracking toggle design
nodes.rationale: Admin master on/off for device tracking lives in app_settings (key 'device_tracking_enabled') with no schema change; 'Case Closed' is a plain status string in inquiries.status; only a per-ticket device_service_enabled flag is added to inquiries.

nodes.label: Drop FKs on Hostinger device logs
nodes.rationale: FIXED_MIGRATION.sql recreates device_taken_logs/device_return_logs/device_follow_up_logs WITHOUT foreign keys and uses LONGTEXT, to avoid FK creation failures on Hostinger phpMyAdmin where the referenced inquiries/profiles tables or engine constraints caused migration errors.

nodes.label: Sensitive-path refuse before compress
nodes.rationale: compress.py hard-refuses files matching credential/secret/key heuristics before reading because compression ships raw bytes to the Anthropic API, a third-party data boundary. Also verifies backup readback before overwriting the primary to avoid corrupt backup + compressed primary.
